cues.event: Mode changes, menu navigation, pause opening, modal navigation, and teach-page changes
cues.decision_reason: A compact physical selection sample gives repeated navigation clearer identity while retaining the tone only for load or decode failure.

cues.event: Start, resume, retry, quit confirmation, and modal close actions
cues.decision_reason: The dedicated confirmation sample communicates accepted actions more clearly than the generic rising oscillator.

cues.repetition_pattern: Three evenly spaced one-shots per run
cues.decision_reason: A dedicated clock-like tick separates countdown timing from generic menu navigation.

cues.event: The GO label appears and gameplay is about to start
cues.decision_reason: A dedicated positive cue creates a stronger start signal than reusing the generic confirm sound.

cues.event: A marble collides with the board, wall, obstacle, or another marble
cues.timing: On the physics collision event with a 60 ms retrigger guard
cues.decision_reason: A light plate impact gives the marbles a believable hard-surface transient and tolerates bounded pitch and gain variation.

cues.event: A marble settles into a target hole
cues.decision_reason: The physical drop sample supplies the missing material cue while the short rising tone remains useful as precise reward feedback.

cues.event: A marble leaves the table and triggers the reset beat
cues.timing: On fall confirmation before the failure spin
cues.decision_reason: A friendly error sample reads as failure immediately without becoming harsh or injury-like.

cues.event: All beetles are captured on a non-final level; the leaf bows, the camera pulses, beetles glow, and the time bonus appears
cues.timing: Immediate on the win presentation; the 0.52-second multiplier shout ends with a 70-millisecond runtime fade
cues.repetition_pattern: Up to seven one-shots per run
cues.license_status: User-directed reuse from the Kiwii-AI h5-police-jump repository at commit 21e1c8e. Internal provenance is recorded, but the legacy asset has no separate upstream license record.
cues.decision_reason: The user clarified that the desired cue is the very short 'yeah' heard on an x2 multiplier. The exact h5-police-jump chain is x2 multiplier -> sfxMult() -> sfxShout() -> people-shout-oo2.mp3.

cues.event: The eighth board completes and the Dune crowd cheer starts at the finish crossing

cues.timing: Immediate, zero delay, simultaneous with well-done, definition gain 0.72 multiplied by Dune runtime gain 1.05
cues.repetition_pattern: Exactly once per successfully completed eight-level run
cues.license_status: Byte-identical Dune production asset with recorded Pixabay Content License provenance.
cues.decision_reason: The user requested the current Dune completion sound exactly, so Mossfall uses the identical file, trigger boundary, one-shot behavior, and gain.

cues.timing: On each visible score increment beat
cues.repetition_pattern: Rapid repeated one-shots during result calculation
cues.decision_reason: A tiny tick sample remains clear under rapid repetition and avoids oscillator fatigue.

cues.event: A result star or new personal record is revealed

cues.repetition_pattern: One to four reward one-shots per result
